data.title: Pérez-Llorca sets up an Iberia-Latam team in Mexico to respond to growing intercontinental workload | Pérez-Llorca, Law
data.content:
Apart from Lafita’s appointment as Senior Vice President Iberia-Latam, the firm’s governance structure remains unchanged and continues to be led by the International Partnership Board, with Pedro Pérez-Llorca as Senior Partner, Julio Lujambio as Executive Partner and Iván Delgado as International Executive Partner, alongside the Country Chairs: Jorge Mondragón in Mexico, Mauricio Piñeros in Colombia and Luis Miranda in Peru.
